title: [Crash] System.InvalidOperationException: Invoke or BeginInvoke cannot be called on a control until the window handle has been created
author: vndnua
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.InvalidOperationException`
**Message:** Invoke or BeginInvoke cannot be called on a control until the window handle has been created.

### Stack Trace

   at object System.Windows.Forms.Control.Invoke(Delegate method, params object[] args)

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in `a0c5ef53e`, with a caveat about how completely.

**What crashes.** VncSharpCore polls the remote framebuffer on its own thread (`GetRfbUpdates`) and marshals connection loss back onto its control with `Control.Invoke`. That is only legal while the control still has a window handle. Once it does not, `Invoke` throws — on a thread this application does not own, so nothing can catch it and the process dies.
